blurb: Expeditions offers reliable ferry service between Mā’alaea, Maui and Mānele, Lāna’i. The trip across the ‘Au’au Channel takes approximately 1 hour and 10 minutes. Passengers can enjoy views of Maui County islands and seasonal whale watching from December 15 through May 15.
extraNote: 3 round trips per day · Safety and proper training of crew is a priority · Donations are final and non-refundable. · Mā’alaea, Maui and Mānele, Lāna’i ferry terminals · Daily year-round

quotes.author: Derek O. ⋅ Google review
quotes.text: I have taken the Expeditions ferry roundtrip probably 25 times over the years to visit friends on Lana'i. On every occasion the experience has been punctual, professional and pleasant in every way. Can't recommend them enough.

quotes.author: Pam H. ⋅ Google review
quotes.text: Great service for travel between Lahaina, Maui and island of Lanai. Multiple options daily. Our plans were adjusted and working with reservations was easy and polite. Reliable, friendly workers, on-time, and great views!

quotes.author: Becky Y. ⋅ Tripadvisor review
quotes.text: The crew was fantastic they were very accommodating and it was a lot of fun for all the kids on board as well! Learned a ton about the area on the boat ride and also saw some whales! I would highly recommend!

quotes.author: Cary J. ⋅ Google review
quotes.text: A very comfortable ride. On the 6:45 shuttle to Lana’i we got to watch a fiery sunrise through the clouds over Haleakala and the full moon set right on top of Lana’i. Magical.

quotes.author: Mariana C. ⋅ Tripadvisor review
quotes.text: It was a great trip back and forth to Lanai for the day ! Crew are amazing and they know what they are doing. Saw lots of whales both ways which was an added bonus.

quotes.author: Louisaw3 ⋅ Tripadvisor review
quotes.text: Smooth trip, clean boat with comfortable seats and friendly staff. Good communication about tickets and parking. Made our trip enjoyable.

hours: open every day and all holidays from 10 am to 3 pm
